title: Mumbai Cloudburst & Deluge
synopticSummary: Mesoscale convective cloudburst system stalled over northern Mumbai suburbs coinciding with a 4.48m spring high tide, preventing Mithi river discharge into Mahim creek.

timelines.predictionLeadAdvantage: +18 Hours faster than conventional synoptic manual bulletins
timelines.actionProposed: Pre-stage dewatering pumps at Hindmata and Milan Subway; alert suburban railway central control room.

timelines.predictionLeadAdvantage: +10 Hours early warning before office commute commenced
timelines.actionProposed: Suspend non-essential municipal schools and offices; deploy mobile pump units to Kurla West and Dharavi; activate DDMA emergency control room.

timelines.traditionalAlert: Red (Issued only after local flooding began)
timelines.predictionLeadAdvantage: Sufficient lead time to divert CST/Churchgate suburban trains before track submergence at Sion and Kurla
timelines.actionProposed: Order ground-floor evacuation along Mithi River (Kranti Nagar, Dharavi, Kurla); mobilize NDRF motorized rubber boats; shut down sub-stations at risk of water ingress.

timelines.predictionLeadAdvantage: Automated inundation map identified Mithi basin breach 4 hours before distress calls inundated 108 helpline
timelines.actionProposed: Full-scale joint military and NDRF amphibious search and rescue; air-drop rations on stranded suburban trains.

title: Chennai Mega Floods
synopticSummary: Intense Northeast Monsoon depression stalled off Tamil Nadu coast with torrential bands pounding Chennai catchment and Chembarambakkam reservoir simultaneously.

timelines.predictionLeadAdvantage: +16 Hours lead to commence controlled reservoir pre-releases before dam gates were overwhelmed
timelines.actionProposed: Begin stepped release of Chembarambakkam reservoir into Adyar river; alert Velachery and Mudichur community leaders.

timelines.predictionLeadAdvantage: +8 Hours head-start to move airport ground operations and park aircraft on elevated aprons
timelines.actionProposed: Evacuate riverbank settlements along Adyar; preposition rescue dinghies in Tambaram and Kotturpuram; secure ICU generator back-ups in Saidapet hospitals.

timelines.predictionLeadAdvantage: Prevented vehicle pile-ups on GST road by issuing automated SMS route closures 4 hours earlier
timelines.actionProposed: Shut down low-lying electrical feeder pillars across Zone 10 & 13; mandatory evacuation of ground floor residences in Velachery; close airport runway.

timelines.predictionLeadAdvantage: Real-time inundation polygon map directed Army column to cut-off pockets in Mudichur and Kotturpuram
timelines.actionProposed: Deploy armed forces helicopters and NDRF deep-draft motorboats; manage mass relief centers in higher elevated schools.

title: Kerala Flood Deluge (Kochi Basin)
synopticSummary: Active monsoon surge coupled with unprecedented simultaneous opening of 35 dams across Western Ghats including Idukki and Idamalayar reservoirs into Periyar basin.

timelines.predictionLeadAdvantage: +15 Hours window to warn Aluva municipal water treatment plant and downstream river settlements
timelines.actionProposed: Sandbag Aluva Water Treatment Plant pumphouses; inspect Mullassery canal locks; alert fishermen rescue brigades.

timelines.predictionLeadAdvantage: +9 Hours warning to halt flight operations and relocate ground electronics at Cochin International Airport (CIAL)
timelines.actionProposed: Relocate patients from Aluva sub-district hospital; open relief camps in Kalamassery higher educational institutions; issue flood sirens.

timelines.predictionLeadAdvantage: Enabled local Kerala fishermen with traditional trawlers ('Kerala's Coastal Army') to pre-stage at Aluva flyover
timelines.actionProposed: Coordinate fleet of 200+ rescue country-boats; shut down submerged 110kV substations; protect diesel generators.

timelines.predictionLeadAdvantage: VarshaRakshak dynamic routing directed rescue boats around inundated bridges and live wire hazards
timelines.actionProposed: Continuous heli-lifting and boat evacuations; supply drinking water through mobile filtration units.
